title: The Next Craft
description: A 12-hour in-person hackathon by Crafter Station and Next, bringing 300 builders together across Lima, Bogota, Guatemala, Arequipa, and El Salvador to ship real products.

title: Build4Latam
description: An open network of tools, builders, and resources responding to emergencies across Latin America, growing the Build4Venezuela initiative into a regional platform.

title: The Realtime Hackathon
description: A 39-hour online hackathon by Portal and Crafter Station for builders creating multiplayer, live-streaming, real-time location, and agentic AI products.

title: I'm building a WhatsApp MCP!
description: The launch post for Normal, a way to use WhatsApp as a source of information inside ChatGPT and Claude.

title: Building a Claude Code clone
description: I built Cave Code, a minimal coding agent with a ten-word system prompt and a small set of file tools. A practical look at why smarter models need clearer, simpler instructions and more trust rather than increasingly complex harnesses.

title: Vibe Coding Workshop: Prototype Products with Maca.sh
description: A hands-on workshop on my workflow for turning ideas into functional prototypes with coding agents. I shared workflows, skills, and practical ways to think through a product, break down tasks, iterate quickly, and use Maca.sh to prototype at nearly the speed of thought.

title: Viral on Instagram
description: I have recorded a lot of video demos and product launches. This is the first one that went viral: 20k views and 600 likes.

title: Local Background Remover
description: Why pay subscriptions or credits to remove the backgrounds of your images? I created Local Background Remover to fix that. Pay once, use your computer's resources, and remove hundreds or thousands of images. My first product with revenue.

title: text0
description: Cursor for writers. Vercel Hackathon winner, 2025.

title: Opencoder
description: Like Claude Code apps, but works with any model. Run opencode in the cloud.

title: Peruvian Elections 2026 Bot
description: A focused bot for following Peru's 2026 election process and checking election-related updates without digging through official sites.

title: Limon
description: Paste a Google Maps restaurant link and get a shareable landing page built from its public details, photos, contact information, and reviews.

title: Tab
description: Native autocomplete for macOS. Routine suggestions run locally, Deep Suggestions use the cloud only when requested, and every insertion stays under the user's control.

title: Build4Venezuela
description: A humanitarian hackathon and multilingual platform for builders responding to the Venezuela earthquakes. I co-organized the initiative and helped build the project platform.

title: Normal
description: Bring WhatsApp into ChatGPT and Claude to search conversations, summarize busy groups, find forgotten details, and draft replies with explicit permissions.

title: Lupa
description: A knowledge platform for AI agents: semantic search, complete document retrieval, parsing, scheduled refreshes, versioned deployments, and analytics.
